messages:
marta: seeing a small spike in mTLS failures for cert-rotator in ap-southeast around 2026-03-21T01:05Z. Canaries fail TLS verify with issuer mismatch.
kevin: which issuer fingerprint? sample from proxy: expected=ef:11:22 but saw=aa:bb:cc.
devops-bot: ALERT: rotator detected issuer fingerprint mismatch for service=cert-rotator-ap-southeast (rotator-id=504). Shadow cert created and canary flipped.
anita: pulling KMS audit now. Any recent IAM binds affecting prod keystore? We did a cross-region test last week.
audit-bot: KMS Decrypt entries: 2026-03-21T00:58Z principal=serviceAccount:ci-smoke@infra.example.com, 2026-03-21T00:59Z principal=serviceAccount:rotator-ap-southeast. Note: unexpected decrypt by ci-smoke recorded.
marta: ci-smoke shouldn't have decrypt on prod keystore. Who granted that? Check IAM history for the key.
kevin: IAM change: terraform apply 2026-03-20T22:15Z created binding with note "temp: cross-region-smoke". Creator=infra-pipeline@infra.example.com, approver=ops-lead@infra.example.com.
anita: infra pipeline owner says it targeted staging but a variable resolved to prod due to a missing branch check. Could be process gap not compromise.
oncall-ryan: I'm oncall. If decrypt by non-rotator principals touches prod certs we may escalate. Start mitigation steps.
marta: mitigation: 1) revoke the temp binding 2) rotate affected certs to shadow (already in canary) 3) increase KMS audit retention for the key to 60d 4) rotate pipeline tokens used by infra-pipeline 5) provenance sweep for other keys with temp binds in 30d. Assign kevin + anita.
kevin: revoking now: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/.../keys/prod-keystore --member="serviceAccount:ci-smoke@infra.example.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"`  revoke logged.
devops-bot: NOTE: shadow certs active on canary nodes. Auto-promotion scheduled in 30m unless rollback.
anita: forensic query in progress: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2026-03-20T22:00:00Z"' --limit 200'`. Exporting results to sec-bq.
kevin: egress flow check from rotator pod around 00:55Z shows outbound to acme-provider.internal.cdn on normal ports; UA acme-client/2.4. No suspicious external endpoints.
marta: good. Still need to confirm if any production CSR was signed with the unexpected issuer. grep rotator audit for CSR ids near the decrypt timestamp.
anita: joining decrypt events to rotator audit: decrypt by ci-smoke correlated to csr-id csr-3221 but rotator later used internal unwrap and produced cert from internal CA for production. The ci-smoke decrypt did not result in a prod cert being served.
oncall-ryan: that lowers urgency. Treat as process gap. Keep legal notified as precaution.
kevin: infra confirms pipeline var bug; they will patch to assert target project equals staging unless explicit prod flag present. Also adding a deny org-policy for non-owner pipelines to modify prod keystore IAM.
marta: add an immediate org-policy deny and require 2 approvers for any terraform changes touching KMS in prod.
audit-bot: NOTE: KMS decrypt events exported to sec-bq and retention bumped to 60d for key proj/.../prod-keystore.
kevin: rotated the pipeline tokens and cleared temporary credentials used by infra-pipeline run. Also added an alert to flag any future decrypts by non-rotator principals.
anita: follow-ups: 1) provenance sweep for all prod keystore keys for the last 90 days 2) update rotator post-issue smoke to validate issuer fingerprint and sample ALPN 3) add pipeline precondition to block applies to prod keystore without explicit PROD_APPROVE tag.
marta: opening vuln-triage card, labeling process-gap. If anyone finds decrypts by external principals, escalate to P1 and ping oncall.
oncall-ryan: I'll monitor for 24h window. Thanks for the fast rotate and revoke. Keep updates brief here. :thumbsup:
